summary: Implemented adapters.qlib_cn.QlibCNFactorEvaluator per adapter-interface.md §7: qlib.init(kernels=1), one-shot label+PIT load, evaluate/evaluate_shifted via one shared kernel, RankIC and quantile long-short returns, §7.4 meta (including data_version triple and cost_declaration).
